title: Supreme Court Declines to Block Texas App Store Age-Verification Law
detail: The Supreme Court, in brief unsigned emergency-docket orders with no public dissents noted, denied requests from a youth advocacy group and the Computer & Communications Industry Association to reinstate a district court block on Texas's App Store Accountability Act (SB 2420). The law requires age verification and parental consent before minors can download apps or make in-app purchases. The Fifth Circuit had already stayed the lower-court block in June 2026; an expedited Fifth Circuit hearing on the underlying First Amendment questions is set for early August 2026.

media.caption: Supreme Court allows Texas to enforce app store age-verification law pending appeal

title: DOJ Reaches Antitrust Settlement Over Algorithmic Rent-Pricing Coordination
detail: The Justice Department's Antitrust Division filed a proposed consent decree with Willow Bridge Property Company LLC, a major Dallas-based landlord, resolving claims that it violated the Sherman Act by using RealPage's algorithmic pricing tools to share competitively sensitive rent data with rival landlords and align pricing. The settlement builds on prior consent decrees in the same case against RealPage Inc., Cortland Management, Greystar Management, and LivCor; Willow Bridge agreed to stop algorithmic coordination and information-sharing with competitors.

media.caption: DOJ announces proposed antitrust settlement with Willow Bridge over algorithmic rent pricing
